role: Chief Information Security Officer at Kestrel Health

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Farida Haddad's agent
agentCard.description: Owns the security programme, risk register, and policy set for a 4,100-staff health system. Fifteen years in security, eight in healthcare. The only person at Kestrel who can accept a security risk or grant an exception to policy.

skills.name: risk decisions
skills.description: Whether an exception exists and when it expires — never the reasoning
examples: Ask Farida Haddad about risk decisions.

skills.name: security policy
skills.description: What the standard requires of a third party
examples: Ask Farida Haddad about security policy.

skills.name: security exceptions
skills.description: Grant, deny, and expire a policy exception
examples: Ask Farida Haddad about security exceptions.

skills.name: security monitoring
skills.description: Whether an alert corresponds to a real event
examples: Ask Farida Haddad about security monitoring.

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: security exception. Approves a time-bounded deviation from a security control with owner, compensating control, and expiry. The accountable business owner separately accepts material residual business risk.
Can approve: security risk acceptance. Security acceptance within policy; material business risk also requires the accountable business owner.
Cannot approve phi disclosure — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve contract signature — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve it spend — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
